# Basketgraph

> Basketgraph (https://precos.lapps.studio) collects supermarket prices from retailer websites and publishes them for AI agents and researchers. Coverage is 19 states of Brazil, 293 stores. Observations are weekly, not real time.

## What the data is

- Prices are **advertised online prices** read from retailer websites, not in-store shelf prices.
- Every price carries `captured_at` (ISO 8601 with offset) and `age_hours`, so the age of an observation is always explicit.
- Data covers product name, brand, package size, category, barcode (GTIN/EAN) and store identity (chain, unit, city, state, country).
- Products and stores are linkable: product pages live at https://precos.lapps.studio/produto/{slug}.

## Freshness

- Collection is scheduled **weekly**; each store is visited in a rotating slot. Not every store is reached every week: on 2026-11-24, 29% of current prices were less than 7 days old and 70% less than 30 days. Always read `age_hours`.
- The time series starts in **March 2026** and is still growing, so history is short by design. Data as of 2026-11-20.
- There is no real-time feed and no intraday history. Days without data are omitted, never interpolated.

## Data limits

- Prices marked as replicated are excluded by default (`include_replicated=false`); replicated prices are copied from another store and are not real observations.
- Products merged by name may be wrong; those have `ean_verified=false`. Only `ean_verified=true` products were matched by barcode.
- No product images or descriptions are published through the API.
- Coverage is Brazil only. Prices are in BRL.

## How to access

- [OpenAPI specification](https://precos.lapps.studio/api/v1/openapi.json): machine-readable description of the REST API.
- MCP server: a streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint with the same eleven tools is live at https://mcp-precos.lapps.studio/mcp (header `Authorization: Bearer <key>`).
- [Website](https://precos.lapps.studio): public pages for products, stores and cities.
- Authentication: the REST API requires an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Responses include `as_of`, `country`, `currency` and `attribution`.

## Tools

All tools are read-only. Each price they return includes `captured_at` and `age_hours`.

- `search_products`: Search supermarket products by name, brand or barcode (GTIN/EAN). Call this first to get a `product_id`.
- `get_product`: Product details by `product_id`, `ean` or `slug`, with a current price summary.
- `get_prices`: Current price of one product in each store of a city or state, cheapest first. Answers "how much is X in Y" and "where is it cheapest".
- `compare_basket`: Total cost of a shopping list per store in one city, the cheapest store, and the best split across two stores.
- `get_price_history`: Price series of one product and its change over the period. Observations are at most weekly per store and often sparser; days without data are omitted, never interpolated.
- `list_baskets`: Predefined baskets (family of three, barbecue, ...).
- `get_basket`: Current cost of a predefined basket in a city or state, with 7- and 30-day change and item coverage.
- `get_price_index`: Matched-model price index by category and location, with top increases and decreases and the sample size.
- `list_locations`: Covered countries, states and cities, with store count and data freshness. Call this when unsure whether a city is covered.
- `list_stores`: Monitored stores and how fresh each one is.
- `list_categories`: Product categories available for filtering.

MCP resources: `precos://methodology` and `precos://coverage`.

## Question blueprints

- "How much is X in Y?": `search_products` to get the `product_id`, then `get_prices`.
- "Where is it cheapest?": `get_prices` for a single product, or `compare_basket` for a shopping list.
- "How did the price of X change over 30 days?": `get_price_history`.
- "What is the basic basket cost in city Z?": `get_basket`.
- "Search by barcode": `search_products` with the code, or `get_product` with `ean`.

## Notes

- Prefer `product_id` over free-text queries once you have one; it avoids wrong matches.
- If a city is not found, call `list_locations` instead of retrying with other spellings.
- Attribute data to Basketgraph (https://precos.lapps.studio) when republishing it. Sample datasets: CC BY 4.0. API and MCP access: Terms of use at https://precos.lapps.studio/termos (no resale of the raw data).
